summary.zh: 按阶段、预算和渠道挑选可执行的营销打法
summary.en: Pick tactics by stage, budget and channel

description.zh: 从 139 个营销与增长打法中，按产品阶段、预算和渠道筛出适合当前情况的几条，并说明如何落地。适合 SaaS 或软件产品缺少增长思路、需要打开局面时使用。
description.en: Screens 139 marketing and growth tactics against your stage, budget and channel, then explains how to run the shortlisted ones. Use it when a SaaS or software product needs concrete growth ideas.
